headline: Armenia Assesses Eurasian Economic Union Relations Amid Warnings Over Exit Costs
summary: Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan stated that Armenia must re-evaluate its relations within the Eurasian Economic Union, as regional economists warned a withdrawal would carry serious commercial disruptions.
why: Armenia's trade flows and energy supplies are deeply intertwined with the Russian-led EAEU customs bloc.

impacts.name: Armenia
impacts.why: Shifts in EAEU participation could reshape regional trade tariffs and cross-border transport corridors.
